title: Dad’s Spaghetti
tagline: A big pot of meat sauce — Italian tomatoes broken up by hand, seasoned by feel — over thin spaghetti.

steps.text: In a large saucepan, sauté onion in a little oil until limp. Add meat and brown well with a little salt & pepper.
Add tomatoes, tomato paste and water. Stir well, breaking up tomatoes into small pieces. Add garlic powder, oregano, basil, salt and pepper to taste.
Bring to a boil and reduce heat to a simmer. Let sauce simmer covered on low heat for 30 minutes to 1 hour.
Serve over noodles prepared according to package directions. Don’t forget to salt the noodle water, and be sure to drain noodles of all water!
